verdict.rationale: Replicate's own docs index includes a language-specific getting-started guide ('Run a model from Node.js'), and llms.txt says models run 'with one line of code', which suggests first-party client tooling. Neither item explicitly names an official SDK package, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 at all candidate paths. Missing for 10: explicit naming of official SDK packages, the list of supported languages, SDK reference documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK use.
